pages.title: Episode 1, Page 2-2
pages.text: Episode 1, Page 2-2 is the last song of the first episode of Comix Zone, at about 90 beats a minute. The episode ends with a fight against the mother of the mutants. "You've destroyed my children!" she cries, and Sketch Turner answers, "Sorry, Big Mama! It's survival of the fittest."

pages.title: Why Sketch has a rat
pages.text: Sega of America's marketing wanted Joe Pencil, the hero of the first Comix Zone demo, renamed and given a sidekick. Designer Peter Morawiec, a Smashing Pumpkins fan, made him a grunge rocker, but he didn't want a person or a big animal following him around. So Sketch Turner got a pet rat, Roadkill, who "didn't take up a lot of screen space."
